## Learning or maintenance problem

What should improve for a learner, instructor, or maintainer?

## Changes

Describe the affected content, interface, or configuration. Identify any effect on saved progress or scoring.

## Validation

Record TypeScript, build, and relevant manual checks. Distinguish source review from a browser test and identify untested behavior.

## Deployment and rollback

Identify the prior working commit. Remember that merging to a deployment branch can publish the site, including documentation-only changes. Await maintainer approval before merge or deployment.

Confirm that examples, screenshots, and exports contain no personal information or secrets, and that existing attribution is preserved.
